cards.text: Nadia doesn't ask if you're free. She texts an address in Clerkenwell and a time, and then she's waiting on the corner when you get there.

cards.speaker: Nadia
cards.text: "I know we said not yet. That was before something we couldn't explain took a vein we'd done everything right by. I'm done waiting for an explanation to turn up on its own."
Des is already there, on the step, with his coat buttoned to the top. He came. Nobody asked him to and nobody asked him not to.

cards.speaker: Des
cards.text: "For the record, I think this is a mistake. I'd like that written down somewhere."
Nadia holds the door. He looks at it for a moment, then goes in first. It is the least comfortable you have ever seen him.
The office is small and very tidy. The handler stands when you come in, shakes everyone's hand, and asks after Hakim by name.

cards.speaker: Handler
cards.text: "Two things, and I'll be brief. Name a vein you think is weak and I'll tell you whether it is. Name what you want in the ground and I'll find you one."

cards.speaker: Handler
cards.text: "Everything I tell you will be true. You'll pay for it either way. That includes the answers you don't like."
The handler writes a number on the back of a card and slides it across. Nobody is hurried out. There is no need.
